behaviors: Complete source read and endpoint/DTO/bootstrap mapping in BRAIN_ADAPTER_REVIEW.md; this pair does not certify every remaining registry handler. Full mode owns native Rust engine/services, while worker export scope is an explicit full/catalog enum with reviewed declarations intersected with actual installed methods. Electron owns catalog/live methods behind hub-only mode rather than a competing catalog brain.

Typed session subscription is acquired before authoritative seed; lifecycle reconciliation, finish priming, lag recovery, named/status projection, terminal leases, conversation demand, filesystem/library observers, threshold sweeps and wake backstops live in owned runtime services. Wake processing precedes visibility filtering; shutdown closes admission/replies and joins observers before the engine.

Old GET/POST helpers map to actual owned Axum router commands with fixed paths/query encoding and typed JSON values. Spawn DTOs preserve pinned IDs, provider-specific resume/env/instructions/transport fields, canonical model/window selection and first-message acceptance. Message/input/bytes/gate/approval/answer/resize/signal and model/handoff routes use the same daemon handlers; no caller-controlled raw engine RPC is exposed.

Actual registered-handler regression reproduced wrong-type defaults causing gate changes, malformed answer carriers producing PTY input, broadened transcript/conversation reads, malformed approval reason reaching daemon and dropped sender attribution. Per-method validation now precedes every query/effect; omitted/null scalar defaults remain, and only the two known answer string-list DTOs map null entries to Go empty strings before precedence. Empty approval reason is omitted, opaque fields remain accepted.

HTTP socket/SSE reconnect wrappers are architectural replacements: direct owned typed streams do not need reconnecting to a separately owned engine. Optional ExternalDaemon remains read-only hub-only event/catalog observation with bounded cancellation and never supplies full execution handlers or acquires daemon ownership. Named upstream brain info and restricted exports remain tested by provider relay ownership.

Explicit differences: parsed JSON preserves semantic sparse data rather than raw whitespace/key order; success must be valid JSON and ok:false is not claimed as a successful command. Response reads are bounded32MiB. Known refusal statuses remain distinct from ambiguous500/transport outcomes; failed session transport lookup no longer guesses keyboard input. Parent-death/signal handling moves to owning launcher, and Node companion/brain child supervision and obsolete daemon/facade URL knobs are retired.

Serial owned-command dispatch is documented as a separate unproven performance concern awaiting bounded concurrent-call/shutdown reproduction; no concurrency or timing-equivalence claim. Registered stream numeric answerKinds and child-conversation end-to-end extensions remain with the separate handlers/parity review rather than being claimed from the PTY adapter fixture.
